title: Bulletin
lead: The Sunday bulletin: the week’s announcements, this Sunday, the agenda, the meditation. Compose it in one click from the site, correct it, then publish. Anyone can print it or save it as a PDF.
exists_t: This Sunday already has a bulletin
empty_p: Compose the first: the site suggests this Sunday, the week’s agenda and the meditation.
pdf_help: Paste the file’s address (https://…), for example on Google Drive shared with “Anyone with the link”. The site does not host it.
pdf_bad: The address must start with https://
assemble_help: Replaces the automatic sections (this Sunday, agenda, meditation, announcements) with what the site shows for this week. Your free-text sections stay.
assemble_done: Sections filled: {sunday} · {agenda} event(s) · {med} meditation day(s) · {ann} announcement(s)
assemble_nothing: Nothing public to take for this week.
en_note: English is optional: without it the line shows in French.

site.title: This week’s bulletin
site.empty_p: As soon as a bulletin is published you will find it here, to read or to print.
site.not_found_p: It may not have been published.
site.fallback: Part of this bulletin is not translated yet: it is in French.
